stories.headline: About a tonne of cocaine found in eight drums at a rural storage site near Santa Marta, with DEA support
stories.summary: Colombian police, army mountain troops and anti-narcotics officers, backed by the US DEA, located the drums at a hidden site in the Calabazo area of Bonda, close to Tayrona…

stories.headline: Joint forces seize 1,042 kilos of cocaine in Vichada as Meta River offensive passes 2.5 tonnes
stories.summary: Colombia's Navy, army, police and prosecutors recovered the cocaine hydrochloride in La Primavera, Vichada, according to the Defense Ministry, which was announced around October…

stories.headline: Queensland police tie heroin, meth and cocaine hauls to a courier stop and Gold Coast raids in Operation Yankee Saga
stories.summary: A courier was stopped at Marlborough on 9 October carrying 3.1 kg of cocaine and 3 kg of methamphetamine.
stories.quantity: 10.3 kg heroin, 10.4 kg meth, 3.8 kg cocaine
